fetch_cap.policy: earliest sectors kept; full download remains in cache

detrend.rationale: window >> transit duration; robust biweight fit removes stellar variability and instrumental drift without flattening transit morphology

stats.outlier_policy: clip only points > 6.0σ ABOVE the median (upward spikes); downward excursions preserved for eclipse detection

warnings: analysis window: sectors [11, 12, 13] of [1, 4, 8, 11, 12, 13] (82 d span) — search capped at 90 d / 6 sectors for tractable TLS cost
light curve decimated to every 2 sample for the TLS search (23150 points, ~4 min effective cadence)

attention.method: attention rollout (Abnar & Zuidema 2020): composed CLS-token attention through all encoder layers
attention.note: attention highlights where the model looked; it is a diagnostic, not proof of causation

transit_fit.model: batman quadratic-limb-darkened transit, emcee affine-invariant MCMC (period fixed to TLS value)

period_log10.source: transit least squares on detrended photometry
period_log10.reason: orbital period is the primary transit descriptor; log scale spans the search range uniformly

duration_hours.source: transit least squares on detrended photometry
duration_hours.reason: grazing and stellar-eclipse signals last systematically longer

depth_ppm_log10.source: transit least squares on detrended photometry
depth_ppm_log10.reason: eclipsing binaries are far deeper than planets; log scale handles the orders-of-magnitude range

snr.definition: transit depth over its robust uncertainty on the folded signal
snr.reason: measurement reliability of the detected signal

sde.definition: signal detection efficiency (max-mean)/std of the TLS periodogram
sde.source: transit least squares on detrended photometry

log_fap.source: transit least squares on detrended photometry

odd_even_sigma.definition: odd vs even transit depth mismatch
odd_even_sigma.source: transit least squares on detrended photometry
odd_even_sigma.reason: uneven alternating depths indicate eclipsing binaries, not planets

n_transits.definition: distinct transit events inside the observation window
n_transits.source: transit least squares on detrended photometry

v_shape.definition: V-shape metric: width of the folded dip at 20% depth over width at 80% depth, linearly mapped so 0 = flat-bottomed, 1 = purely triangular (grazing-like)
v_shape.reason: primary discriminator between total and grazing eclipses (grazing class)

secondary_ratio.definition: secondary-eclipse depth (phase 0.5 window) over primary depth
secondary_ratio.reason: a detectable secondary eclipse at phase 0.5 is a hallmark of eclipsing binaries (reflective/irradiated companions)

depth_meas_ppm_log10.definition: log10 of independently measured folded depth (median out-of-transit minus median in-transit)
depth_meas_ppm_log10.reason: cross-check on the TLS depth; robust to TLS fit quirks

oot_scatter_ppm.definition: robust (MAD) scatter outside the folded transit
oot_scatter_ppm.reason: noise level context: scales how deep a real signal can be

scatter_6h_ppm.reason: binning separates white noise from correlated/systematic noise — systematic-dominated light curves show relatively high binned scatter

corr_noise_ratio.reason: high values indicate correlated (instrumental/stellar) noise — key evidence for the systematic class

skew.definition: third standardized moment of the flux distribution

kurtosis.definition: fourth standardized moment of the flux distribution
kurtosis.reason: eclipse signals create heavy negative tails

fhigh_frac.definition: fraction of points more than 6 robust sigma above the median
fhigh_frac.reason: flares and instrumental spikes indicate variable/systematic targets

cadence_s.reason: cadence affects detectable durations; also records data provenance

span_days.definition: total time baseline of the analysed data
span_days.reason: baseline limits period coverage and significance attainable

coverage.reason: data-quality indicator (quality-flag and NaN rejection rates)

n_points_log10.definition: log10 of number of analysed samples

Tmag.source: TIC catalog via MAST (never invented; missing stays NaN)
Tmag.reason: brightness sets the noise floor and systematic regime

Teff.source: TIC catalog via MAST (never invented; missing stays NaN)
Teff.reason: stellar type context for expected variability

logg.source: TIC catalog via MAST (never invented; missing stays NaN)
logg.reason: giant stars show different systematics and blend probabilities

MH.source: TIC catalog via MAST (never invented; missing stays NaN)

rad.source: TIC catalog via MAST (never invented; missing stays NaN)
rad.reason: sets the physical scale of detectable transits

mass.source: TIC catalog via MAST (never invented; missing stays NaN)

dist_pc.source: TIC catalog via MAST (never invented; missing stays NaN)
dist_pc.reason: distance plus magnitude indicates crowding/blend risk

contratio.definition: TIC contamination ratio (flux from neighbours over target flux in the aperture)
contratio.source: TIC catalog via MAST (never invented; missing stays NaN)
contratio.reason: high contamination directly implies blend risk — core evidence for the contamination class

numcont.definition: number of neighbouring sources in the TIC contamination estimate
numcont.source: TIC catalog via MAST (never invented; missing stays NaN)

has_periodic_signal.reason: absence of a periodic signal is itself key evidence for the systematic class

has_stellar_meta.reason: marks missing metadata so imputation is visible

series_backfilled.note: chart projections reprojected from an identical analysis of the same target+mode; detection numbers are unchanged
